newsitem.title: USA: Banco de Galicia to redeem obligations.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Galicia to redeem obligations.

text.p: Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires on Tuesday said it would redeem its 7 percent convertible subordinated negotiable obligations due 2002 on Sept 19, 1997.
At that time, holders will be entitled to receive $1,043.75 for each $1,000 principal amount of negotiable obligations with accrued interest, the company said in a statement.
The same principal amount could be converted into 186 class B shares, worth $1,480.73, based on Monday's closing market price for American Depositary Receipts, the company said.
